name: Exp_AdaptiveCyberCycle
summary: This EA trades based on crossover signals from three adaptive cycle-based oscillators (Adaptive Cyber Cycle, Adaptive CG Oscillator, or Adaptive RVI). It opens buy positions when the main line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with fixed stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于三种自适应周期振荡器（Adaptive Cyber Cycle、Adaptive CG Oscillator或Adaptive RVI）的交叉信号进行交易。当主线从下方穿越信号线时开多仓，反之时开空仓，并使用固定的止损和止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 该策略基于John Ehlers的自适应周期理论，通过Alpha参数控制平滑系数来动态调整振荡器的周期响应。入场条件为：当主线（Value）向上穿越信号线（SigValue）时产生买入信号，当主线向下穿越信号线时产生卖出信号，属于经典的振荡器交叉策略。出场条件包括：固定止损（1000点）和固定止盈（2000点），同时当反向交叉信号出现时会平掉当前持仓。仓位管理方面，MM参数支持两种模式：负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数，通过TradeAlgorithms.mqh库实现。资金管理依赖于外部交易算法库，自身未做额外的风控检查如最大持仓限制或回撤控制。策略默认在H4周期运行，使用SignalBar=1确保只在确认K线收盘后交易，避免信号闪烁。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is based on John Ehlers' adaptive cycle theory, using the Alpha parameter to control the smoothing coefficient and dynamically adjust the oscillator's cycle response. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the main line (Value) crosses above the signal line (SigValue), and a sell signal on the opposite crossover, following a classic oscillator crossover approach. Exit conditions include a fixed stop loss (1000 points) and fixed take profit (2000 points), while opposing crossover signals also trigger closing of existing positions. Position sizing supports two modes via the MM parameter: negative values represent fixed lot sizes while positive values represent deposit-proportional sizing, implemented through the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library. Money management relies on the external trading algorithm library without additional risk controls such as maximum position limits or drawdown protection. The strategy defaults to H4 timeframe and uses SignalBar=1 to ensure trading only after confirmed bar closure, avoiding signal repainting.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款比例或固定手数，负值为手数
parameters.description_en: Deposit percentage or fixed lot; negative = lot size

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 支持三种自适应周期振荡器算法切换，灵活性强
使用SignalBar=1确保在K线收盘确认后交易，避免信号重绘
止损止盈参数完备，且允许独立控制买卖方向的开关
新K线检测机制避免同一K线内重复交易
pros_en: Supports switching between three adaptive cycle oscillator algorithms for flexibility
Uses SignalBar=1 to trade only after bar closure confirmation, avoiding signal repainting
Complete stop loss and take profit parameters with independent buy/sell direction controls
New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated trading within the same bar
cons: 依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库，核心交易逻辑不可见，难以审计风控细节
没有点差过滤、最大持仓限制或回撤保护等额外风控措施
固定止损1000点和止盈2000点的比例可能不适合所有市场环境
指标句柄获取失败时仅打印警告但未阻止EA继续运行，可能导致无信号交易
cons_en: Depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library with invisible core trading logic, making risk control auditing difficult
Lacks additional risk controls such as spread filter, maximum position limits, or drawdown protection
Fixed 1000-point SL and 2000-point TP ratio may not suit all market conditions
On indicator handle failure only prints a warning but does not prevent the EA from continuing, potentially leading to signal-less trading
improvements: 在指标句柄获取失败时应在OnInit中返回INIT_FAILED而非继续运行
增加点差过滤和最大同时持仓数限制以增强风险控制
improvements_en: Return INIT_FAILED in OnInit when indicator handle acquisition fails instead of continuing to run
Add spread filter and maximum simultaneous position limits to enhance risk control

risk_points: 指标句柄获取失败时EA仍继续运行，CopyBuffer失败可能导致反复重算
没有点差过滤，在新闻或低流动性时段可能因大点差而入场
依赖外部库的资金管理逻辑不可审计
risk_points_en: EA continues running even when indicator handle acquisition fails, and CopyBuffer failures may cause repeated recalculation loops
No spread filter, potentially entering trades during news events or low liquidity with wide spreads
Money management logic in external library is not auditable
